segments.sn20.11:1.2: “assuttha no tumhe, bhikkhave, rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ jarasiṅgālassa vassamānassā”ti?
segments.sn20.11:1.4: “Eso kho, bhikkhave, jarasiṅgālo ukkaṇḍakena nāma rogajātena phuṭṭho.
segments.sn20.11:1.5: So yena yena icchati tena tena gacchati;
segments.sn20.11:1.6: yattha yattha icchati tattha tattha tiṭṭhati;
segments.sn20.11:1.7: yattha yattha icchati tattha tattha nisīdati;
segments.sn20.11:1.8: yattha yattha icchati tattha tattha nipajjati;
segments.sn20.11:1.10: Sādhu khvassa, bhikkhave, yaṃ idhekacco sakyaputtiyapaṭiñño evarūpampi attabhāvapaṭilābhaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha.

lines: Ekādasame yena yena icchatīti so jarasiṅgālo icchiticchitaṭṭhāne iriyāpathakappanena sītavātūpavāyanena ca antarantarā cittassādampi labhatīti dasseti.
So hi ettakampi cittassādaṃ anāgate attabhāve na labhissatīti.
Ettakampīti iminā jarasiṅgālena laddhabbaṃ cittassādamattampi na labhissati sakalameva kappaṃ sabbaso avīcijālāhi nirantaraṃ jhāyamānatāya niccadukkhāturabhāvato.
